# Google API schemas

Unmodified Apache-2.0 schemas from googleapis/googleapis commit `ab5c1b0777e6f1f7c89bd0eb55b05532d97b68e0`.
The adjacent LICENSE applies to these imported files. Protobuf well-known types come from the pinned vendored protoc distribution.
